title: White Bean and Kale Soup
description: A quick Tuscan-style soup of creamy white beans, kale, garlic and rosemary in broth, partly mashed for body. Ready in 35 minutes.

image.alt: A bowl of white bean soup with kale

steps.text: Heat the oil in the pot over medium heat. Cook the onion and carrot until soft, {time 6-8 min}. Add the garlic, rosemary sprig and pepper flakes and stir for {time 1 min}.
Add the beans, broth and salt and bring to a simmer. Cook for {time 10 min}.
Remove the rosemary stem. Mash about a quarter of the beans against the side of the pot to thicken the broth.
Stir in the kale and simmer until tender, {time 5-7 min}. Add the lemon juice, taste for salt and serve with a drizzle of olive oil and crusty bread.

notes: Not vegan? Simmer a Parmesan rind with the beans for extra depth, and grate some cheese on top.
